title: VidEngram: Agentic Long-Term Video Understanding via Structured Hierarchical Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.18578v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-video question answering is wasteful and lossy when a multimodal model must re-encode the same video for every query: context limits force sparse sampling or truncation, and no reusable representation remains for later questions. We present VidEngram, an agentic video QA system that builds a persistent hierarchical memory once at ingest and answers later questions from that memory. VidEngram captions video and audio jointly with Qwen2.5-Omni, consolidates segment memories into episode and entity layers, and uses a text-only agentic planner with specialized retrieval tools to produce grounded answers. The web interface makes this process inspectable: users can watch memory formation, inspect retrieval traces, verify cited evidence in the video player, and explore entity relationships. On the full OmniVideoBench, VidEngram with a GPT-5-mini planner outperforms a strong single-pass Qwen2.5-Omni baseline (37.0% vs. 32.3%), with gains

translated_title: VidEngram：通过结构化分层记忆实现智能体式长时视频理解
translated_abstract: 当多模态模型必须为每个查询重新编码同一视频时，长视频问答既浪费资源又有信息损失：上下文长度限制迫使模型进行稀疏采样或截断，且不会为后续问题保留可复用的表示。我们提出了 VidEngram，一个智能体式视频问答系统，它在视频摄取时一次性构建持久化的分层记忆，并基于该记忆回答后续问题。VidEngram 使用 Qwen2.5-Omni 对视频和音频进行联合字幕生成，将片段记忆整合为事件层和实体层，并使用配备专用检索工具的纯文本智能体规划器来生成有据可依的答案。其网页界面使这一过程可被检视：用户可以观看记忆的形成过程、检查检索轨迹、在视频播放器中验证所引用的证据，并探索实体之间的关系。在完整的 OmniVideoBench 上，配备 GPT-5-mini 规划器的 VidEngram 优于强大的单次处理 Qwen2.5-Omni 基线（37.0% 对 32.3%）。
tldr: VidEngram 通过在视频摄取时一次性构建持久化的结构化分层记忆（片段、事件与实体层），并利用纯文本智能体规划器配合专用检索工具回答后续问题，实现了高效、可检视的长视频问答，在 OmniVideoBench 上超越了单次编码基线。
en_tdlr: VidEngram builds a persistent hierarchical memory once at video ingest and uses a text-only agentic planner with specialized retrieval tools to answer long-video questions, outperforming a strong single-pass baseline on OmniVideoBench.
